title: The tensor of a homogeneous fraction piece embeds after scalar extension
statement: Let R→S be a map of commutative rings, A a nonnegatively graded R-algebra with grading 𝒜, f∈𝒜_n with n>0, and j an integer. Define H as the R-span in A_f of a/f^m with a∈𝒜_i and i=j+mn. Every element of H is one such fraction. If B is an S-algebra, β:S⊗_R A≃_S B, and ψ:𝒜→ℬ is graded with β(1⊗a)=ψ(a), then there is an injective S-linear map S⊗_R H→B_{ψ(f)} sending s⊗z to s times the localization of ψ applied to z. No flatness or regularity is assumed.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01MY and 01N2; explicit standard-open tensor and denominator calculations written by Z8

proof.text: Construct H as the explicit span of homogeneous fractions. Multiplication of numerators by powers of f gives common-denominator transition maps. The span induction shows that every element of H is a single homogeneous fraction, and tensor induction gives a common-denominator tensor numerator in S⊗𝒜_i.

The localized algebra map ψ is R-linear by β(1⊗a)=ψ(a); extend it S-linearly to define L. If L(x)=0, a power of ψ(f) kills its numerator. Pull this relation back through β. Injectivity of the inclusion S⊗𝒜_(i+kn) into S⊗A, furnished by the direct-sum grading, makes the transitioned tensor numerator zero. The fraction transition identity proves x=0. All steps are implemented with Mathlib tensor products, graded-piece base change and the ordinary localization zero criterion.

theorem exists_twistChartFraction_tensor_embedding
    {R S A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S B]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) (ℬ : ℕ → Submodule S B)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (β : TensorProduct R S A ≃ₐ[S] B) (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hβψ : ∀ a : A, β (1 ⊗ₜ[R] a) = ψ a)
    (j : ℤ) (n : ℕ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ L : (S ⊗[R] twistChartFractionSubmodule 𝒜 n f j) →ₗ[S]
        Localization.Away (ψ f),
      Function.Injective L ∧
      ∀ (s : S) (z : twistChartFractionSubmodule 𝒜 n f j),
        L (s ⊗ₜ[R] z) = s •
          IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away f) (Localization.Away (ψ f))
            ψ.toRingHom f (z : Localization.Away f)
